recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中倍下，背景小淋巴球大多陰性，陽性細胞呈瀰漫散佈而非結節聚集，其中不少為中空環狀的膜染色輪廓（大細胞或 rosettes），呈現 NLPHL 較瀰漫、T 細胞豐富的變異型態。
features: Diffusely scattered positive cells without nodular aggregation
Many ring-shaped membranous positive profiles with unstained centers, compatible with large positive cells or rosettes
Smaller positive cells interspersed between the ring profiles
Antibody identity not labeled; cytologic detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at medium power shows scattered positive cells distributed diffusely among a predominantly negative small lymphocyte background, without a nodular arrangement. Many positive profiles are ring-shaped with unstained centers, which may represent membranous staining of large cells or rosettes of positive small cells around unstained large cells; smaller positive cells are interspersed. Findings in a case of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma suggest a diffuse, T-cell-rich variant area; interpretation requires the marker identity and correlation with CD21 for residual follicular dendritic meshworks to separate it from T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL is separated by an entirely diffuse CD8+ T-cell background, few or no PD-1+ rosettes, and absence of CD21+ meshworks.
HRS cells in LRCHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells are CD20+/OCT2+ and CD30-/CD15-.
Reactive paracortex contains scattered immunoblasts within preserved nodal compartments without ringed large atypical cells effacing the node.
